meta.name: site-architecture
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "plan my site structure" or "design the page hierarchy / navigation / URL taxonomy"; designs whole-site information architecture — hierarchy, nav, URL patterns, hub/spoke clusters, link topology — and outputs Mermaid site maps that expose orphans and islands. Not for optimizing links on existing pages — use internal-linking-optimizer; not for XML sitemap or indexation issues — use technical-seo-checker. 网站架构/信息架构/站点地图

copy.tagline: 规划网站页面层级与导航结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计网站的整体页面结构和导航路径。
copy.tagline_en: Plan site page hierarchy and navigation structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design the overall page structure and navigation paths for a website.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计整个网站的结构，包括页面层级、导航、网址格式和主题集群，并生成一张 Mermaid 站点地图，标出孤立页面和链接孤岛。
howto.when: 当你要求“规划网站结构”、“设计页面层级/导航/网址分类”，或者需要可视化站点地图来发现孤立页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个新 SaaS 营销网站的页面结构。
say.note: Claude 会输出层级树、URL 表和导航方案。

say.text: 重新设计我现有网站的导航和网址分类。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有页面并给出重组建议。

say.text: 为我的博客围绕“SEO”设计主题集群。
say.note: Claude 会规划中心页面和关联文章。

howto.what_en: Claude designs the whole-site information architecture: page hierarchy, navigation, URL taxonomy, hub/spoke topic clusters, and link topology. It outputs a Mermaid site map that exposes orphan pages and link islands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'plan my site structure', 'design the page hierarchy / navigation / URL taxonomy', or request a visual sitemap that surfaces orphan pages or link islands.

say_en.text: Plan the site structure for a new SaaS marketing site.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a hierarchy tree, URL map, and navigation spec.

say_en.text: Restructure my existing site — pages feel buried and disorganized.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the current structure and suggests improvements.

say_en.text: Map hub/spoke topic clusters for my blog around 'SEO'.
say_en.note: Claude plans pillar and cluster pages with cross-links.
